text:
maya_ops: Heads-up — reservation queue for eu-west H100 pool just jumped to ~10 weeks. A couple of high-priority requests from product landed on my desk and they need capacity by mid-quarter.
alex_infra: Ugh. We're seeing the usual seasonality + one large commitment from a new partner. Lead time pushed past our SLA for new requests.
sam_sre: Do we have any spare capacity in us-west or eu-central that we can borrow/poke? Network egress & latency might be okay for batch jobs.
maya_ops: We have ~8 nodes idle in us-west but cross-region traffic for logging & KV cache will add latency. Product wants interactive throughput (low p99 < 350ms) though.
jen_product: That 350ms p99 is for demo envs only — can we accept slightly higher latency if it means meeting the deadline? Also we can reduce sequence length for demos.
lucy_billing: Cost note: cross-region routing will incur egress + inter-region networking charges. We can put a short-term budget on this (charge code RND-DEMO) but long-term reserved commit needs procurement/PO.
alex_infra: Options I see:
- Option A: Short-term cross-region spill (us-west -> eu-west) for 6-8 weeks; accept egress costs.
- Option B: Accelerate an on-demand reserved allocation by swapping some low-util reserved reservations in eu-central -> eu-west (live migration) — risky.
- Option C: Convert some spot/ephemeral workloads to preemptible reserved via negotiated burst credits.
sam_sre: Can we do Option A with traffic shaping? Throttle logs + batch KV prefill to cut egress 40%.
maya_ops: I'm leaning Option A + throttle, unless procurement can fast-track a partial reserved commit.
lucy_billing: Procurement timeline is typically 4-6 weeks for a partial commit for Dedicated. We can do a provisional charge and then retroactively convert to reserved if PO completes.
reservations-bot: Reservation queue snapshot (2027-03-12 09:12 UTC): eu-west-H100: pending=42, active=126, eta=72d; us-west-H100: pending=8, active=98, eta=10d.
alex_infra: Reservation bot confirms. So short-term cross-region is feasible.
maya_ops: If we go cross-region, we need a clear rollback: when eu-west reservations free up, move workloads back. Also document perf delta for product.
jen_product: I can lower demo sequences and disable non-essential background calls to reduce tokens — should cut p99 by ~70ms per run according to our internal perf tests.
sam_sre: Quick plan:
1) Approve temporary allocation: 8 nodes from us-west to be used by product (6 weeks)
2) Network team to apply egress throttle: limit log throughput to 2MB/s for demo cluster
3) Observability flags: tag requests with "temp-cross-eu" and run perf histogram
4) Billing: Lucy to attach charge code and flag for conversion to reserved if PO clears

alex_infra: I'll push a short Terraform snippet for the reservation request and a routing rule. Example:
```
resource "redwood_reservation" "temp_uswest_to_eu" {
  region_from = "us-west"
  region_to   = "eu-west"
  gpu_type    = "h100"
  count       = 8
  duration_weeks = 6
  tags = ["temp-cross-eu","product-demo"]
}
```

maya_ops: Thanks Alex. Can you also add a TTL/cancel hook at 6 weeks so we don't forget to revert?
alex_infra: Yep, will set an automated cancellation and a 48h notify before teardown.
lucy_billing: I'm okay to approve provisional budget up to $30k for the window. If PO comes in we convert; if not we escalate to finance for extra runway.
jen_product: I'll update the demo runbook with perf expectations and a message for the sales demos: "May experience slightly higher latency while we're temporarily rebalancing infra" — will minimize impact.
sam_sre: Can someone create the ticket in tickets-infra with links to the reservation resource and the perf dashboard? I'll attach a quick checklist for rollback.
maya_ops: I'll create the ticket and ping ops when it's ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
alex_infra: Creating reservation now. Will post resource id and ETA in this thread.
reservations-bot: Reservation request submitted: id=rsv-20270312-447, estimated provision time: 12m.
alex_infra: rsv-20270312-447 active. IPs assigned. Tagging live in infra for monitoring.
maya_ops: Verified demo cluster can start. Early perf looks within acceptable range (+60ms p99). Closing the short window; we'll re-evaluate at week 4.
